transcript.text: Good morning. Let's get started with the maintenance-priority board. We've got one replacement controller available today, and it can go to only one of three systems: generator G-7, water purification unit W-2, or clinic refrigeration bank R-1. I need each of you to report your current section constraints so we can make the right call. S-4, let's start with you — what's the situation from your side?
